LanguageData.KeepYourGear.KeepColonistsWeaponsTip: Keep weapons with colonists, slaves and colony animals of the player faction when they are downed or lose the use of their hands. A kidnapped colonist drops their gear where they were grabbed.
LanguageData.KeepYourGear.KeepColonistsInventoryTip: Keep inventory items (including cargo on colony pack animals) with the player faction when they are downed. Stripping still works; kidnapping drops the gear where the pawn was grabbed.
LanguageData.KeepYourGear.KeepGearOfImprisonedColonis: Keep weapon and inventory with your own colonists when they are arrested and imprisoned - for example to end a mental break - instead of dropping their gear in the cell. They still have everything when released. An imprisoned colonist who breaks out will be armed.
LanguageData.KeepYourGear.KeepWeaponsAndInventoryOfDe: Keep weapons and inventory of dead colonists

Keep weapons and inventory on the body when a colonist dies, instead of dropping them on the ground - independent of the two options above. Strip the body to take the gear; it is destroyed when the corpse rots away.
LanguageData.KeepYourGear.KeepOtherPawnsWeaponsTip: Keep weapons with non-player pawns (raiders, visitors, wild people) when they are downed or lose the use of their hands. Capturing them drops the gear - right at the pickup spot if they were hostile; rescue by their own faction carries the gear away.
LanguageData.KeepYourGear.KeepOtherPawnsInventoryTip: Keep inventory items with non-player pawns when they are downed. Their carried goods no longer scatter on the ground - strip them, or capture them, to take the items.
LanguageData.KeepYourGear.KeepWeaponsAndInventoryOfOt: Keep weapons and inventory of other dead pawns

Keep weapons and inventory on the body when a non-player pawn dies, instead of dropping them on the ground - independent of the two options above. Strip the body to take the gear; it is destroyed when the corpse rots away.
LanguageData.KeepYourGear.DebugLoggingTip: Log every kept and vanilla drop decision to the game log: pawn, caller and decision. For verifying behavior and bug reports. Dev mode only.
